title: psbt-spec corpus file, schema v1
description: One file per BIP: the BIP revision it was labeled against, the BIPs it exercises, and its vectors. Applies to bip174, bip370, bip371, bip373, bip375 and bip376. Known-answer and non-PSBT files (bip322_basic, bip341_wallet_vectors, bip353_proofs, bip370_locktime, bitcoin_core_sighash, bip340_vectors.csv) are outside this schema. Whether a vector isolates its rule is decided by the all-failures evaluation (tests/corpus.rs), not by this label.

bip_revision.description: Short commit of bitcoin/bips the file was labeled against.

bips.description: BIP numbers the file exercises (the evaluator also adds 174 or 370 from each PSBT). A vector's own bips add to these.

task.description: The entry point. Absent means validity, the General rules (evaluate).

psbt.description: Base64. For role tasks, the PSBT the role is given (finalizing, extraction) or returned (combining).

valid.description: Whether the task's entry point accepts the vector.

rule.description: The rule ID the entry point stops at. Present exactly when valid is false.

outcome.description: Set to incomplete when rule is reported Incomplete rather than Failed.

note.description: Free text. A triage class (confounded, lagging, ambiguous, defect) starts the note, followed by a colon.

bips.description: Optional extension BIPs enabled for a single vector, added to the file-level bips.

combine.description: Combining only: the base64 PSBTs that were combined.

unique_id.description: Combining only: the expected unique ID, hex; null when not checked.
